# Li Hang Ping — OMA Labs

> Official professional profile of Li Hang Ping, a full-stack developer and IoT architect at OMA Labs. His work spans software development, connected hardware, system architecture and AI automation.

Li Hang Ping has 7+ years of experience and holds a B.Sc. Hons in Game Development from KDU University College Glenmarie, Shah Alam.

## Profile and services

- [Professional profile](https://profile.omalabs.cc/): Introduction to Li Hang Ping and OMA Labs.
- [Background](https://profile.omalabs.cc/#about): Education and software and hardware experience.
- [Services](https://profile.omalabs.cc/#services): Full-stack development with Laravel and Flutter; PCB design and IoT integration with Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi; system architecture; AI automation and LLM integration; technical consultancy; delivery from concept to maintenance.
- [Technology stack](https://profile.omalabs.cc/#stack): Software, hardware, AI and infrastructure tools.
